title: page=0 and enabled=false vanish from API requests
prompt: Clients report that requesting page 0 or sending enabled=false drops the parameter entirely, so the backend falls back to its defaults. lib/params.mjs is specified to drop ONLY null, undefined and empty-string values — a real 0 or false is a meaningful value and must survive. Fix lib/params.mjs and verify with your own script (zero, false, empty string, null, undefined, lone values, input not mutated) before answering.
